title: callicarpa pedunculata var. longifolia
intro: Callicarpa pedunculata var. longifolia, commonly known as the Purple Flame Vine or Purple Queen, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents of Callicarpa pedunculata var. longifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
